deploy-bot: :warning: AUTO-PIN triggered: runtime v7.0 pinned for model-group 'dialogue-mix' in ap-northeast-1. Signal: kernel-select fallback to slow scalar path on bfloat quant matrices causing p95 spike and increased 4xx for streamed responses. Link: https://ops/inc/1702509999. CC @marta @evan

marta: noticed user reports of cut-off streams and retries around 09:12 JST. logs show a sudden shift to scalar matmul on certain tiny-batch shapes after sdk 6.1.1 rolled at 08:45.

evan: yep, sdk change introduced an optimizer that prefers fused kernels only when sequence_length % 16 == 0; for short-chat sequences it ends up choosing scalar fallback and inflates latency. i'll pause the sdk canary.

triage-bot: Suggested immediate mitigations:

```
/deploy pin runtime v7.0 --model dialogue-mix --region ap-northeast-1 --reason "kernel-select fallback + stream retries" --until 2024-09-04T20:45Z
/deploy route add --from runtime:v7.0 --to runtime:v6.9 --region ap-northeast-1 --match "header:x-stream=true && header:x-batch-size<=8"
/deploy canary pause sdk 6.1.1
```

marta: applied the header-route for streamed small batches. saw stream retry count drop 90% in the last 10m. p95 back near baseline for affected flows.

evan: opening a quick fix PR to the SDK to change kernel selection heuristics and add an opt-in fused-kernel flag. PR: https://git/repo/pull/8022. will also add unit tests covering odd-length sequences.

sasha: proposing soft-unpin plan: wait for PR merge + two successful canary runs (24h), then soft-unpin during low-traffic window 02:00 JST. ramp: 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 12m evaluation gates. Auto-rollback criteria: stream-retry-rate > baseline+50% OR p95 > baseline+35% OR 4xx > 5 in 10m. If triggered, immediate rollback to v6.9 and notify #eng-oncall.

triage-bot: Monitoring rule suggestion added: if stream retry count > 10 in 5m for model-group dialogue-mix in ap-northeast-1, page eng-oncall and set runtime to v6.9 automatically.

marta: i'll draft the internal release note: "Pinned runtime v7.0 in ap-northeast-1 after SDK 6.1.1 caused suboptimal kernel selection for short streaming batches; routes added to v6.9 for affected streaming traffic. SDK patch + staged unpin planned." will push to #release-notes-draft after approvals.

evan: follow-ups: (1) land SDK PR + re-run kernel-select regression suite, (2) add CI check for fused-kernel fallback conditions, (3) collect gate snapshots during each ramp. i'll own 1 & 2.

sasha: i'll own the soft-unpin orchestration and gates. ping if auto-rollback fires. keep this thread updated with PR and metric screenshots. closing when unpin fully completes and postmortem posted. :lock:
